description: Add a withRetry wrapper around an async fetch helper
prompt: Implement withRetry(fn, { retries, delayMs }) in retry.js so that retry.test.mjs passes. It should call fn, retry on thrown errors up to `retries` times (so total attempts = retries + 1), wait delayMs between attempts (use the provided sleep helper), and rethrow the last error if all attempts fail. Do not modify the test file.
verify: node retry.test.mjs && git diff --quiet HEAD -- retry.test.mjs
